purpose: Verify that nre/event_acquire.py, which replaced the per-event scripts nre/slsn_acquire.py and nre/cxt_acquire.py, reproduces the derived labels recorded for SLSN and CXT on 2026-09-23 from freshly retrieved live Alpaca data.

provenance.result_channel: check-run annotation 'NRE event acquisition' via the public annotations API

what_this_shows: The unified fetch -> bundle -> nre.dataset.build() path reproduces, digest for digest, the 16 derived labels (values and reasons) that two separate per-event scripts recorded three days earlier.
The provider bars that feed those labels and the corporate-action history for both windows did not change between the two retrievals, as far as the derived labels can detect.
Attestation gating, calendar-derived windows and the recorded-result pins work in production, and the annotation channel returns results without any job-log access.
what_this_does_not_show: Not a new event and not progress toward the 20-event target: 1 eligible complete event (SLSN) across 1 issuer. CXT is included and mapped, but its dividend-suppressed session-20 label means it does not count toward the minimums.
Not Milestone 1 acceptance; milestone_accepted remains a human declaration outside the code.
The pin detects changes in the derived labels only; a provider revision that leaves every label unchanged would not be visible.
raw_data_policy_note: Only derived values, digests and public corporate-action identifiers appear here; no raw OHLCV.
